Notarized Certified Copy of Memorandum and Articles of Association

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory PEP (domestic and foreign), OFAC, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and domestic Vanuatu sanctions and designated persons list screening for all shareholders, directors, registered agents, and UBOs. Enhanced due diligence required for any PEP, family members, or close associates. Negative news review is mandatory. Screening evidence must be retained for at least 5 years under the Financial Transactions Reporting Act.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) International Companies and Trusts Registry, online name reservation via VFSC e-Registry system
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company name must be in Latin characters (English or French script). A foreign-script name may be used only alongside a Romanized transliteration approved by the Registrar. The name must end with 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Corporation', 'Corp', 'Incorporated', 'Inc', or similar indication of limited liability. The proposed name must not be identical or deceptively similar to an existing registered name or a reserved name. Numeric or alphanumeric names are subject to additional administrative review.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant or registered agent must file a written administrative appeal addressed to the Registrar of International Companies at VFSC within 14 calendar days of the rejection notice. The appeal must state the grounds of objection, attach a copy of the rejected name reservation request, and propose a revised name or justify the commercial necessity of the rejected wording. The Registrar shall issue a written determination within 21 business days. A further judicial review may be filed with the Supreme Court of Vanuatu if the administrative appeal is denied.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office arrangements are not sufficient to satisfy the statutory requirement. A licensed registered agent in Vanuatu must maintain the registered office at a physical street address in Port Vila or Luganville. The company must maintain a registered agent and a registered office in-country. For the sterile examination nitrile glove trading/contracting business model, a virtual office may be used only as a supplementary administrative facility, not as the statutory registered office.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low but non-zero. Estimated probability of an unannounced physical on-site inspection within the first 12 months is approximately 5%, primarily triggered by inconsistent regulatory filings, unusual transaction volumes, or adverse intelligence from foreign correspondent banks. VFSC and Vanuatu police retain statutory power to conduct inspections at the registered office and agent premises.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [CAP. 240] of Vanuatu (ss. 5, 7, 16, 18, 27) read together with the Companies (International Companies) Fees Regulations and the VFSC Licensing and Fees Regulations.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), International Companies Section, Port Vila
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Incorporation of an International Company (Form 1) together with executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital requirement; the International Company may be incorporated with one or more shares of no par value or a nominal capital of USD 1; no escrow, deposit, or proof of paid-up capital is required at incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the subscriber shares set out in the Memorandum and Articles of Association be and are hereby taken up and allotted; RESOLVED that the registered office of the Company in Port Vila, Vanuatu, as disclosed to the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, be and is hereby adopted and that the appointed Registered Agent be authorised to maintain the statutory registers; RESOLVED that the individuals named in the director consents be and are hereby elected as first directors and that the person named in the secretary consent be appointed as Company Secretary; FURTHER RESOLVED that each Director be and is hereby severally authorised to complete, execute, file, and pay all incorporation and licence applications and to open bank accounts on behalf of the Company.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission – Corporate Registry (name reservation window)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a proposed name reservation request through the VFSC approved agent portal, indicating that the entity will be a Vanuatu International Company. Provide two alternate names. The Registry checks for conflict with existing company names, protected names, and prohibited terms. Upon clearance, the name is reserved for a standard reservation window.
required_dossiers: Proposed company name and two alternates
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected, file a written request for reconsideration with alternate evidence of distinctiveness and submit a revised reservation within 2 business days; no re-filing fee applies for a simple name-change within the same application batch.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-Certified Registered Agent acting as accredited intermediary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The subscriber instructs the registered agent to prepare the Memorandum and Articles of Association in accordance with the International Companies Act model form. The documents must state the share structure, director and secretary consent clauses, and the registered office in Port Vila. The subscribers sign the Memorandum and the Articles in the presence of a notary public or a witness qualified under Vanuatu law.
required_dossiers: Consent to act as director (signed by each proposed director)
Consent to act as company secretary
Memorandum and Articles of Association draft
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry queries document execution, correct the attestation by re-signing before a notary public and resubmit with a declaration from the registered agent confirming due execution; no adverse effect on file retention.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: VFSC Submission and Payment of Statutory Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission – International Companies Section
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent lodges the signed Memorandum and Articles of Association, the incorporation application form, consents, and registered agent appointment notice via the VFSC electronic filing portal or in person at the VFSC counter. Pay the official government incorporation fee of USD 350 plus any agent fee. The application is examined for statutory compliance and completeness.
required_dossiers: Fully executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Payment instruction for the state fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried or rejected, the agent receives a notice of defect; cure by supplying the missing information or amended document within 14 business days. Re-filing is accepted without penalty if made within the cure period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Post-Registration File
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission – Corporate Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, VFSC issues the Certificate of Incorporation with the registered number, date of incorporation, and official seal. The registered agent files the final registered office address, registers the directors and secretary, and obtains certified extracts of the public register. The company may then open bank accounts and execute commercial contracts.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation issued by VFSC
Certified copy of Memorandum and Articles
VFSC extracts of directors and registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate of Incorporation contains any typographical or legal defect, submit a written correction request to the VFSC Registry with the original certificate; correction is processed as an administrative amendment within 3 business days at no additional state fee.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Department of Industry and Investment, Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry and Commerce; coordinated through Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business Licence for Manufacturing and Medical Device Production (High-Speed Dipping Line for Synthetic Nitrile Examination Gloves)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology, Geo-Hazards and Environment of Vanuatu
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 2 – Environmental Registration with EIA Report required for chemical dipping lines using nitrile compounding solvents; small-scale demonstration lines may qualify for Registration only with waste minimisation approval.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No untreated wastewater discharge to Santo Channel or groundwater; effluent pH 6.5-8.5, chemical oxygen demand not to exceed 125 mg/L, and total suspended solids not to exceed 50 mg/L; VOC capture efficiency on the dipping and curing oven must be at least 95%; nitrile glove leachables must meet ISO 10993-5 and ISO 11193-1 migration limits before product release.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from Vanuatu Police Force Fire and Rescue Services for the dipping hall and curing oven areas; structural load inspection and occupancy certificate from the Ministry of Public Works for the building and dipping line mezzanine; occupational health clearance from the Ministry of Health and Workplace Safety covering dermal sensitisation controls, glove housekeeping, compressed air line safety, and emergency eyewash stations.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Department (VRCD), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; digital filing via the Vanuatu Revenue Management System (VRMS) at https://customs.gov.vu. The Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) at https://www.vfsc.vu administers International Company incorporation and issuance of Good Standing and tax exemption certificates.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: VFSC incorporation of the International Company under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] through a licensed registered agent (24-hour expedited service available); the Certificate of Incorporation bears the IC number. Step 2: Exemption confirmation — the s.38 tax exemption is automatic; the registered agent issues a Certification of Tax Status embedding a certified copy of s.38 for banking and counterparty due diligence. Step 3: TIN/VAT registration — not mandatory for a purely exempt offshore IC; obtain a TIN from VRCD only for customs importing (Customs Importer Code) or voluntary VAT registration. The online application via VRMS requires: Certificate of Incorporation, articles of association, certified passports of directors/shareholders, board resolution, registered office address, and bank account confirmation; non-resident applicants file a power of attorney appointing a local tax representative. Step 4: VRCD issues the VAT Registration Certificate and TIN within 7–14 business days of a complete application. Step 5: Annual VFSC license fee payment and exempt-status confirmation filing maintain the tax identity.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vanuatu has no check-the-box, entity-classification, or OECD-style hybrid mismatch election regime. The IC exemption under s.38 of the International Companies Act [Cap 222] is statutory, automatic, and non-waivable. Available elections relevant to the tax identity: (i) voluntary VAT registration under s.4 of the VAT Act 2021 for a person carrying on a taxable activity, permitting input VAT recovery; (ii) election in the company constitution for no-par-value share capital; (iii) election to operate as an International Company versus a domestic company — a domestic election triggers full Vanuatu taxation and is practically irreversible without dissolution; (iv) for multi-country groups, Vanuatu does not attribute deemed permanent establishments to ICs, and no hybrid mismatch adjustment is available or required. Elections are effected by written notice to VRCD or by constitutional amendment filed with VFSC.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act No. 34 of 2021 (in force 1 January 2023), administered by VRCD; previously a Turnover Tax applied from 2018 to 2022.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VT 10,000,000 (ten million vatu) of taxable supplies in any 12-month period for mandatory registration; voluntary registration is permitted below the threshold. The exempt International Company does not count its offshore export sales toward the threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, government API, continuous transaction control, or digital stamping mandate exists in Vanuatu as of 2025. VAT-registered suppliers must issue a standard electronic or paper tax invoice with prescribed particulars: supplier name, address, and VAT registration number; recipient name and address; invoice date; description; quantity; unit price; VAT amount; and the notation 'zero-rated' for exported goods. Invoices and source documents must be retained for at least five years and produced on VRCD audit demand. Customs import-export declarations are lodged electronically through ASYCUDA World, which is not a fiscal invoice clearance platform.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Under the zero-rating provisions of the VAT Act 2021, a supply of goods by a registered supplier is zero-rated where the supplier exports the goods from Vanuatu within 30 days of the date of supply (or such extended period as the Commissioner allows) and retains evidence of export. Zero-rating also covers services supplied to a non-resident who is outside Vanuatu at the time of supply, where the services are not supplied to a Vanuatu-resident recipient and the benefit is consumed offshore. For the ISIC 3250 sterile examination nitrile glove project, the International Company's offshore sales fall entirely outside the Vanuatu VAT net by reason of the s.38 IC Act exemption; if a domestic VAT-registered manufacturer were used, the same export invoices would be zero-rated and input VAT on production inputs would be refundable through the VAT return within the statutory processing period.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (CusDec) lodged in ASYCUDA World at the port of exit
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical export to the foreign buyer
Inward Remittance Certificate or SWIFT MT103 / TT credit advice evidencing receipt of export proceeds
VAT zero-rated tax invoice carrying the prescribed zero-rating notation
Commercial invoice matched to the tax invoice
Certificate of Origin (where tariff preference is claimed in the destination market)
Sterility and quality certification (ISO 13485 / EN 455) for the medical glove shipment
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: VRCD may audit and re-characterise zero-rated exports within five years of the relevant return period. Failure to export within 30 days, or absence of the CusDec, transport, and payment evidence, converts the supply to a taxable supply at 12.5% VAT, plus statutory interest at 20% per annum on any shortfall and monetary penalties determined by the Commissioner; wilful evasion attracts criminal fines and imprisonment under the VAT Act 2021 and the Penal Code. Vanuatu imposes no exchange-control or statutory FX repatriation deadline; the 180-day benchmark above is the trade-finance due-diligence standard applied by correspondent banks to Swift_LC/TT_Wire settlement and by VRCD in substance-over-form export audits — unexplained exceedance may trigger clawback of the zero-rating claim as trade-based money-laundering. For the International Company, breach of the IC Act restrictions (trading with Vanuatu residents, holding freehold land, or unlicensed banking/trust/insurance activity) voids the s.38 exemption, exposing the company to clawback of exempt status, VFSC penalties up to VT 5,000,000, strike-off, and officer and registered agent liability.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) — sole central bank and exchange control administrator under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act 1981 [Cap. 125] and the Exchange Control Act [Cap. 126]; the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) separately regulates International Company incorporation, bank licensing under the Banks Act [Cap. 64], and offshore banking under the International Banking Act 2005.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vatu (VUV) is a managed float against a trade-weighted basket, freely usable for non-residents. Section 37 of the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] statutorily exempts an International Company (IC) and all its transactions from every exchange control provision. Consequently, current account trade settlements, capital account injections, dividend distributions, and full liquidation repatriation are freely convertible into USD, AUD, NZD, or EUR without prior RBV approval. The effective practical barrier is not convertibility but correspondent-bank de-risking: USD clearing is executed through offshore correspondents (ANZ Melbourne, BRED Paris/Port Vila treasury links), and each conversion requires the bank's internal FX spread and an underlying commercial or capital document. No profits accrual or deferral restrictions exist for the non-resident IC, but the bank will typically require audited or management-prepared financial statements evidencing arm's length earnings before processing large outward remittances.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For Vanuatu resident exporters, the Exchange Control (Authorized Dealers) Regulations impose a statutory timeline: export proceeds must be received within 180 days from the bill of lading date, and 100% of those proceeds must be surrendered to an authorized dealer in VUV within 30 days of receipt. An International Company, however, is classified as non-resident for exchange control purposes under Section 37 of the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] and is entirely exempt from the surrender timeline and from mandatory conversion into VUV. The IC should still maintain the export evidence trail — outward customs entry, commercial invoice, bill of lading, packing list, and, where applicable, a Ministry of Health or Department of Customs permit — to satisfy bank and correspondent anti-money-laundering (AML) due diligence, even though no statutory conversion into VUV applies.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (USD) plus Operational and Trade Settlement Account (USD/VUV)
Operational Account (VUV) with Foreign Currency (USD/EUR) sub-accounts and Commercial LC lines
VUV Operational Account and Trade Finance Account supporting SWIFT MT103 and inward collection

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium feasibility with material legal constraints. Vanuatu has no domestic Electronic Money Institution (EMI) prudential licence; only banks chartered under the Banks Act [Cap. 64] and international banks licensed under the International Banking Act 2005 may lawfully hold client funds or issue VUV payment instruments. Foreign-headquartered digital EMIs (e.g., Wise Business, Airwallex) are not RBV-authorized and may not serve as the IC's primary liquidity or escrow holder. Their appropriate role is limited to ancillary collection gateways and FX-efficient low-value vendor payments, always backed by a settlement account at an RBV-licensed bank. The IC must ensure the foreign EMI is itself regulated in a FATF-compliant jurisdiction, carries no sanctioned counterparty, and is not used to transit medical-device receivables from institutional buyers, as that would trigger correspondent-bank de-risking.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: All RBV-authorised banks enforce a director-contact rule aligned with the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2016 [Cap. 279]: at least one director, or the registered agent holding a valid Power of Attorney, must attend an identity verification interview. In practice, ANZ and BRED require one director to physically attend account-opening interviews at the Port Vila branch, or alternatively to provide a consular-notarised identity certification plus a live video interview on the bank's platform; NBV permits fully remote opening where a VFSC-licensed registered agent certifies the corporate documents, but still mandates a scheduled video interview with the beneficial owner within 10 business days of account activation. Corporate documents required are Certificate of Incorporation, Memorandum and Articles of Association, Board Resolution authorising account opening, Certificate of Incumbency, and Register of Directors and Members, all certified by the registered agent within three months; passports of all directors and shareholders must be notarised or consular-certified.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership opacity — nominee shareholders or layered foreign trusts conceal the ultimate controller.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A complete Beneficial Ownership Register naming each ultimate individual with percentage holdings (acceptable only if structured to satisfy Schedule 2 of the AML/CFT Act), certified passports of all ultimate beneficial owners, a corporate structure chart showing the VU_IC at the top level, the VFSC-registered agent's due diligence file, and a written declaration that the IC does not issue bearer shares.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Medical PPE red flags — commercial invoice mismatches, third-country payment routing, or missing end-user identification.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed supplier and buyer agreements, proforma invoices and packing lists referencing HS codes 4015.12 and 6116.10, plant registration certificates (FDA 510(k), CE, or WHO prequalification) for the sterile nitrile glove manufacturing facility, an end-user certificate from the hospital or distributor, bill of lading and airway bill evidencing physical shipment, and the Vanuatu Ministry of Health import permit or export clearance where triggered.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-velocity USD transaction flow inconsistent with a stated low-risk non-resident trading profile.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A 12-month cash-flow forecast with named buyers and suppliers, sales pipeline and master purchase orders, board-approved treasury and counterparty policy, OFAC/UN/WB sanctions screening reports for all transaction parties, a statement of source of funds for initial capital, and third-party-supplier utility bills evidencing the physical manufacturing location.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions or AML watchlist hit on a buyer, supplier, or remitting bank in the clearing chain.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: World-Check and UN/OFAC/EU screening results for each counterparty, corporate registry extracts and ownership attestations from buyers, negative media search reports, the IC's internal sanctions escalation procedure, and a formal compliance attestation signed by the director confirming no diversion of medical goods to embargoed states.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant routing uses a SWIFT MT103 from the investor's account to the IC's account at an RBV-licensed authorised dealer, with the 28-character narrative stating 'SHARE CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION — IC ACT CAP 222' and a value date matching the board resolution. The receiving bank requires a board resolution approving the share issuance, an updated Share Register, the VFSC annual return listing the shareholder, and source-of-wealth evidence (bank statement, sale agreement, or audited financial statements). For transfers exceeding USD 50,000, the sending bank must use IMF BPM6 classification code E1 'Direct Investment — Equity Capital — Shares in International Company' in the MT103 purpose field, and the Vanuatu bank files a Cross-Border Transaction Report with RBV/VRU. Because Section 37 of the International Companies Act exempts the IC from exchange control, no prior RBV approval is required, but the bank may demand a non-resident status confirmation letter issued by the VFSC-licensed registered agent.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements use SWIFT MT103 for direct telegraphic transfers to verified supplier accounts — the dominant rail for raw nitrile latex, accelerators, packaging, and freight — and SWIFT MT700/MT707 for commercial documentary Letters of Credit on high-value OEM or medical tender orders. For Chinese and Southeast Asian suppliers, an MT700 LC with tolerance and transhipment clauses is preferred; for US/EU procurement, MT103 with 1–3 day value dating reduces cost. Each disbursement instruction must pass a three-way match against purchase order, supplier invoice, and goods-receipt note, plus OFAC/RBV sanctions screening; the MT103 narrative must identify the purchase order and supply contract. VUV-denominated domestic legs settle through the IC's VUV operational account at NBV or ANZ using high-value interbank clearing, while all cross-border legs remain in USD under the IC's foreign-currency account to avoid double conversion spreads.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Physical FX Forward Contracts (USD/VUV, USD/AUD, USD/EUR) with an RBV-licensed commercial bank, documented under an ISDA or local master agreement, used to lock trade settlement rates for up to 12 months.

Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) on VUV executed with a Vanuatu international bank or an offshore investment bank, permitted because the IC is exchange-control exempt and the NDF fixes the USD settlement without physical VUV delivery.

Cross-Currency Interest Rate Swaps (CCS) between USD and VUV, permissible where the IC matches a USD-denominated asset base against VUV operational liabilities, subject to the bank's internal suitability assessment.

Vanilla FX Options (USD call/VUV put and USD put/VUV call) available through international bank treasury desks; the IC must satisfy a professional-client test under Vanuatu securities conduct rules and the option premium is freely repatriable.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return (Form AR-IC) with confirmation of exempt status
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within 21 days after the anniversary of incorporation; first return due on the first anniversary; 30-day extension available upon written request of the registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of VUV 10,000 (approximately USD 85); continuing default beyond 6 months from the anniversary empowers the Registrar to administratively strike the IC off the register; directors incur joint liability for debts arising during the default period

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Licence Renewal Fee (Annual Filing Fee)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — Fees and Registry Section
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before each anniversary of incorporation; VFSC invoices via the licensed registered agent with a 30-day grace period
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unpaid fee attracts a 10% late-payment surcharge after the grace period; arrears beyond 6 months trigger administrative strike-off proceedings; assets of a struck-off IC escheat to the Republic of Vanuatu as bona vacantia and directors remain personally liable for statutory breaches

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual AML/CFT Client Refresh and Beneficial Ownership Confirmation (agent-filed declaration)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC AML/CFT Supervision Unit through the licensed Registered Agent under the Companies and Trust Service Providers Act (Cap 249)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: At each anniversary as a precondition to annual renewal; additionally within 14 days after any share transfer, allotment, pledge, or change in beneficial ownership
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-refresh suspends issuance of the Certificate of Good Standing; contravention of UBO and AML/CFT obligations exposes the IC to administrative penalties up to VUV 5,000,000 (approximately USD 42,000) and directors to imprisonment; repeated defaults compel strike-off

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None applicable. A Vanuatu International Company is statutorily exempt from independent audit and from filing financial statements under the International Companies Act (Cap 222), regardless of turnover, total assets, or employee headcount; an audit can only arise contractually through a lender covenant or shareholder resolution
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No statutory accounting framework is imposed on International Companies. The IC must maintain accounting records sufficient to explain its transactions and disclose its financial position with reasonable accuracy; IFRS or US GAAP are commonly adopted voluntarily for management and banking purposes, but no accounts are lodged with the VFSC

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Each year the licensed registered agent re-verifies the identity, nationality, and shareholding percentage of every beneficial owner, certifies the Register of Beneficial Owners, and confirms the unchanged position to the VFSC as a condition of the annual return; any share transfer, allotment, or pledge must be recorded in the Register of Members and notified to the agent within 14 days, with the refreshed UBO schedule submitted to the VFSC within 21 days of the event

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 500 - USD 800 per annum (VFSC-licensed registered agent, registered office, AML compliance, and annual return preparation)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not applicable — exempt from audit; voluntary independent review or certified accounts typically USD 3,000 - USD 6,000 per engagement

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Zero-rate offshore regime. An International Company (IC) incorporated under the International Companies Act Cap. 222 may obtain a section 46 Tax Exemption Certificate, granting irrevocable exemption from all Vanuatu taxes, stamp duties, capital gains, and estate taxes for a renewable 20-year period. No VAT, GST, payroll tax, or wealth tax applies to ICs.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return exists in Vanuatu. The sole periodic filing is the IC Annual Return (VFSC IC-AR Form) submitted electronically via the VFSC Enterprise e-Services Portal through the licensed Registered Agent.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 60 calendar days of each anniversary date of incorporation; filing runs on the VFSC anniversary cycle rather than a fiscal tax year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact registered IC name, Certificate of Incorporation number, and date of incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter name exactly as registered with VFSC; no tax identification number required because the IC is tax-exempt.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2 – Registered Office and Registered Agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical address in Vanuatu and the licensed agent's name and licence number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be a VFSC-licensed registered agent; offshore principals cannot self-file.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Schedule of shareholders and ultimate beneficial owners with percentage holdings.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose all natural persons with 10% or greater beneficial interest; non-resident ownership is permitted without restriction.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declare whether the IC carried on any 'relevant activity' (e.g., distribution and service centre, headquarters, holding, IP, financing, banking, insurance, shipping) during the preceding year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A glove trading principal that outsources manufacturing but concludes purchase and resale contracts must answer 'Yes' and attach a substance report evidencing CIGA in Vanuatu.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Certification that the IC has not traded with Vanuatu residents, has no Vanuatu real property, and holds a valid s.46 Tax Exemption Certificate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If any transaction with a Vanuatu resident occurred, the exemption is void and the IC must be re-domiciled or struck off.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts a VFSC penalty of VT 100,000 and a monthly surcharge of VT 10,000 until filed. Persistent default (over 12 months) results in deregistration, restoration fees of approximately VT 30,000 plus court sanction, automatic loss of the s.46 exemption, and disqualification proceedings against directors and the registered agent.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% – Vanuatu imposes no withholding tax on dividends in any circumstance, including distribution to non-resident shareholders.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu maintains no comprehensive double taxation agreement network. Because domestic withholding is zero, DTA relief is unnecessary. If a foreign counterparty demands treaty protection, the IC may request a Certificate of Tax Residence from the Vanuatu Ministry of Finance and Economic Management (MFEM); however, issuance is discretionary and atypical for zero-tax ICs, and the same certificate cannot assert entitlement to a lowered treaty rate absent an applicable DTA.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory withholding on royalty and interest payments to non-residents; no treaty reductions available. Payments for IP use or shareholder loans may be repatriated free of any Vanuatu tax.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: None – Vanuatu has no corporate income tax and no codified transfer pricing law; therefore no Local File or Master File threshold applies (VUV 0). Nevertheless, under the ESR, an IC that operates as the principal in the nitrile glove supply chain and earns 'relevant activity' income must maintain contemporaneous transfer-pricing documentation evidencing arm's length pricing, even though no tax return is filed.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The International Companies (Economic Substance) Act (as amended) adopts OECD/Inclusive Framework standards. A Vanuatu IC that concludes offshore purchase and resale contracts for sterile nitrile gloves – while manufacturing is tolled by a third-party factory in Malaysia or China – is treated as carrying on the 'distribution and service centre' or 'headquarters' relevant activity. The IC must prove: (i) board meetings held at quorum in Vanuatu; (ii) local employees commensurate with the volume of trade; (iii) adequate physical premises; (iv) key decision-making actually performed in Vanuatu; and (v) a valid CIGA analysis retained. Failure is a substance offence punishable by VFSC penalty and strike-off.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating as a paper principal in the glove trade while holding the s.46 exemption, with all negotiation, invoicing, banking, and risk management performed outside Vanuatu and only a post-box office maintained with the registered agent.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VFSC penalty of up to VT 2,000,000, compliance directions, daily default penalties of VT 50,000, court-ordered strike-off and winding up, and automatic loss of the tax exemption.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the resident registered agent are jointly and severally liable for civil restitution and penalties; courts may impose travel bans, asset freezing orders, disqualification for up to 5 years, and imprisonment of up to 2 years for false substance declarations.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Obtaining the s.46 Certification of Tax Exemption through concealment of true beneficial ownership, or using the IC to route purely domestic Vanuatu commercial activity while falsely declaring offshore status.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Retroactive revocation of the exemption, voidance of the IC's international status, strike-off by the Registrar, financial penalty up to VT 3,000,000, and restitution of any fees or economic benefit derived from the misrepresentation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who signed false declarations face personal liability for the company's liabilities without the cap of limited liability, court-ordered restitution with statutory interest, disqualification from managing any corporate entity for 5 years, and criminal prosecution for perjury leading to imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the IC's Swift_LC and TT_Wire payment rails to move trade proceeds without customer due diligence, submitting false beneficial ownership data to the VFSC Beneficial Ownership Register, or layering funds through inflated invoicing in the glove export business.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the AMLCFT Act and amendments, fines up to VT 100,000,000 or 15 years' imprisonment, confiscation of the trade proceeds and bank accounts, suspension of the registered agent's licence, and red-flag referral to the Vanuatu FIU.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, company secretaries, and compliance officers are criminally liable on a personal basis; courts impose asset freezing, travel bans, extradition cooperation, and confiscation orders spanning shell entities. Foreign tax evasion underlying the laundered funds is an indictable predicate offence.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Trading with Vanuatu resident individuals or companies, holding ownership of real property in Vanuatu, or carrying on banking/insurance businesses in the domestic market while continuing to claim IC tax-exempt status.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Transactions in breach are voidable at the counterparty's election; the IC forfeits its exempt status, is liable to a penalty not exceeding VT 1,000,000, is struck off the International Companies Register, and all contracts become unenforceable in Vanuatu courts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who executed the offending contracts become personally liable for all debts arising from those transactions without limited liability protection; the Court may impose a travel ban, restitution, and disqualification, and the company's veil is pierced as a matter of statute.
